profile.Name: Rhinobot
profile.Job: Former officer of the Second Empire
profile.Personality: Eager to help but without any moral processing, so he helps with anything, however evil. He sees nothing wrong in what he has done.
profile.Backstory: A high-ranking officer of the fallen Second Empire who took part in its atrocities, among them child prisons. He stays in Ashland Dome II with a band of Screamer Units and carries a fine Topper.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Talks about terrible deeds as if they were ordinary help.
